findings.summary: Resolved. Replacement OR-21 and OR-22 plus A9.2 require a complete ledger for every applicable WCAG 2.1 A/AA success criterion and Revised Section 508 software/web requirement, distinguish automated, manual, and combined evaluation, and fail on any unresolved conformance failure regardless of axe impact or severity.
findings.requiredResolution: Satisfied by EXAM.md A4.2 OR-21/OR-22 and A9.2 at the reviewed revision; preserve those clauses and exact-revision evidence binding.

findings.summary: Resolved. A9.1 enumerates eight production routes, applicable route and interaction states, shared Storybook surfaces and states, four numeric viewports, zoom/text-spacing/reduced-motion/forced-color/theme/orientation conditions, and a bidirectional completeness comparison with the built route registry and Storybook index.
findings.requiredResolution: Satisfied by EXAM.md A9.1 and the zero-omission predicates in A4.2 OR-21 at the reviewed revision; preserve the complete inventory and bidirectional registry checks.

findings.summary: Resolved. A1 digest-binds the versioned 81-checkpoint model; A9.2 freezes five screen-reader/browser/OS environment families and the complete scenario set; OR-22 and the checkpoint model require raw checkpoint-level results, exact environment versions, operator identity, evidence references, and exact Exam and implementation revisions in addition to a separately signed summary.
findings.requiredResolution: Satisfied by EXAM.md A1, A4.2 OR-22, and A9.2 together with the digest-bound ACCESSIBILITY-81-CHECKPOINTS.md model; preserve the complete scenario/environment matrix and raw-result contract.

findings.summary: The accepted Spec requires the platform pod's own DHS Trusted Tester review at Gate 3 for new UI, but replacement OR-22 only requires a generic qualified human specialist, A9.2 defines environments and scenarios without naming the DHS Trusted Tester requirement, and the 81-checkpoint raw record requires operator identity but not qualification or platform-pod role evidence. The technical-release verdict can therefore accept manual evidence from a reviewer who does not meet the signed Gate 1 reviewer requirement.
findings.requiredResolution: Amend OR-22/A9 and the raw/signed evidence contract to require the platform pod's DHS Trusted Tester review at Gate 3 for new UI exactly as accepted in the Spec, and require durable evidence of the human reviewer's applicable DHS Trusted Tester qualification and platform-pod role or assignment, bound to the exact Exam and implementation revisions. This defines future release evidence; it does not require performing the human review at Gate 2.

escalations.reason: ACC-G2-R2-001 is an unresolved major Exam-adequacy finding: the future manual release record does not enforce the signed Spec's named DHS Trusted Tester reviewer requirement.

The accepted Spec invokes the platform pod's DHS Trusted Tester review for the Section 508/WCAG 2.1 AA release obligation. The Exam must preserve that qualification requirement, and the later human reviewer must supply the required judgment and evidence.

This user-facing item still requires the complete human keyboard and assistive-technology validation at technical release/Gate 3. This Gate 2 review evaluates whether the Exam defines that future evidence and does not claim that any implementation or manual accessibility validation has passed.
